JournalEntry.title: Journal Entry
JournalEntry.description: A human-authored bookkeeping construct (memoriaalboeking / recurring template / reversing accrual). Posting one materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction with its GLLine children. Distinct from the GLTransaction it produces.

journalNumber.description: Sequential journal number unique per administration + fiscal year.
journalNumber.title: Journal Number

description.description: Human-readable description of the journal entry.
description.title: Description

lines.description: The entry's booking lines. Each line books an amount on one account, debit or credit, optionally on a cost centre and a project.

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.
side.title: Side

amount.description: Non-negative line amount in the administration's base currency.
amount.title: Amount

costCenterCode.title: Cost centre
costCenterCode.description: The cost centre this line is booked on.

projectCode.title: Project
projectCode.description: The project this line is booked on.

lines.title: Lines

sourceDocumentUri.description: FK to a docudesk attachment URI. The file content lives in docudesk; no blob is embedded here (ADR-022).
sourceDocumentUri.title: Source Document URI

sourceDocumentApp.description: Origin app of the source document URI.
sourceDocumentApp.title: Source Document App

journalType.description: Closed enum of the three T1 sub-types. manual: one-off memoriaalboeking; recurring: cadence-driven template; reversing: auto-inverting accrual.
journalType.title: Journal Type

cadence.description: Required when journalType is `recurring`, forbidden otherwise. Consumed by OR's ScheduledWorkflow primitive (ADR-031) to materialise a GLTransaction per tick.

endsOn.description: Optional end date; null for open-ended.
endsOn.title: Ends On

count.description: Optional bounded number of materialisations; null for unbounded.
count.title: Count

cadence.title: Cadence

reversesOn.description: Required when journalType is `reversing`. Names the periodId whose start triggers the inverse posting.
reversesOn.title: Reverses On

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once posted.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

approvalState.description: Approval-workflow state, driven by OR's approval-workflow extension. No app-local approval table (ADR-022).
approvalState.title: Approval State

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this entry.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: editable; pending: awaiting approval; posted: materialised GLTransaction exists, immutable; voided: superseded, queryable for audit only.
state.title: State

sourceApp.title: Source ledger
sourceApp.description: The ledger this journal entry comes from. A bank booking may post its VAT line; a payroll journal may post on payroll accounts. Empty for an entry made by hand.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Lines may be added or changed before submission or posting.

pending.label: Pending approval
pending.description: Submitted and awaiting an approver per administration policy. No GLTransaction exists yet.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Materialised into a balanced GLTransaction. Immutable.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Superseded; its materialised GLTransaction has been reversed. Remains queryable for audit, excluded from default listings.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Submit a draft journal entry for approval when administration policy requires it.

post.label: Post journal entry
post.description: Approve and post. Gated by OR's approval-workflow extension; on approval, materialises exactly one balanced GLTransaction. No app-local approval logic (ADR-022).

actions.description: Materialise exactly one balanced GLTransaction (with GLLine children derived 1:1 from `lines`) and set glTransactionId. Declarative outcome / design D3: no PHP orchestration.

postDirect.label: Post without approval
postDirect.description: Post directly when administration policy does not require approval. approvalState must be `not-required`. Materialises one balanced GLTransaction.

actions.description: Materialise exactly one balanced GLTransaction (with GLLine children derived 1:1 from `lines`) and set glTransactionId.

reject.label: Reject
reject.description: Approver rejection returns the entry to draft and sets approvalState to `rejected`.

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted journal. Requires the materialised GLTransaction to already be reversed.
